title: Destination Haunted
description:
S01 E05 — Salem
Hunt for the truth in Massachusetts; Salem's ghosts -- including that of the first woman hanged for witchcraft -- reveal things about the city's infamous witch trials; a message from a man executed in the worst way imaginable.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E09 — The Labyrinth, Spirits in a Material World, Bed 23
An IT technician embarks on an intensive job trial at a large hospital and encounters multiple paranormal phenomena within its labyrinthine halls; a psychiatric nurse experiences frightening otherworldly encounters.

title: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
description:
S04 E02 — Shaun Williamson
Sailing off to Shaun Williamson's Isle of Sheppey home, where a shadowy female figure waits at the window; facing a violent specter during a spirit-trigger session; seeing if the soul of a wife killer is destroying the peace in the actor's house.

title: Paranormal Mysteries
description:
Buried Secrets
Legend says Ashmore Estates is shrouded in shadows and mystery. But as the team investigates, they uncover a haunting with a purpose; one that runs deeper than ghost stories and reveals a reason that changes everything.

title: Paranormal Mysteries
description:
Haunted Homecoming
Return to Ashmore Estates with the team and follow the trail to Robbin Terry's home, the R Theater; witness similar paranormal activity, which points to another mysterious connection and a revelation.

title: Paranormal Mysteries
description:
Paper & Fire
Touring the infamous Pauly Jail in Union Springs, Alabama, where Shane once had a life-changing experience; listen as chilling voices echo through the abandoned cells and spirits desperate to share.

title: Paranormal Mysteries
description:
Mother's Shame
Exploring the legend of Matilda Sorrel and her ties to the historic Sorrel-Weed House in Savannah, Georgia; getting chills when Shane, Dave, and Cindy visit this former estate and discover things.

title: Paranormal Mysteries
description:
Blood Ties
Visit a shrine where all faiths converge, then stand back as the team discovers a tear in its spiritual shield; witness a ritual; watch hidden secrets surface.

title: Paranormal Mysteries
description:
When the Children Cry
Strolling down the corridors of the Old Hospital on College Hill in Williamson, West Virginia; exploring reports of childlike laughter echoing through the building, then try to find an explanation.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E03 — Strathroy Paranormal Looping
Exploring Strathroy, an Ontario community with a dark past plagued by fires, train wrecks and serial killers; confronting the paranormal energy that engulfs the town and makes its residents the uneasy neighbours of poltergeists and phantoms.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E02 — Bellaire Paranormal Ley Lines
Stepping into the crosshairs in Bellaire, a village that sits on a focal point for paranormal energy; exploring the bloody history of warfare, mining disasters and mass casualties that make this town a haunted hot spot.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E01 — Child Ghosts
Going up against tortured young souls who are trying to throw three homeowners out of their dream houses; tales of abuse, ominous orbs of light, angry phantoms, haunting lullabies and dark figures that are scaring these residents to death.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E05 — Haunted Battlegrounds
Marching into three small towns where the American Civil War once raged; crossing paths with terrifying entities that make residents' skin crawl; meeting a man who unwittingly awoke malevolent spirits while trying to preserve his town's history.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E06 — Poltergeists
Uncovering the identity of rage-filled things that go bump in the night; going ghost hunting in a community theater in a town with a violent past; visiting a spooky honky-tonk; chasing a phantom that's trying to eject a historical home's new owner.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E07 — Disturbing the Dead
Investigating the consequences of not letting the deceased rest in peace; learning how a plot of Mississippi land and a Michigan dream home became living nightmares; meeting a Pittsburgh man who got more than he bargained for in his vintage home.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E04 — Tortured Spirits
Getting close to lost souls that have been distorted by their trauma; braving the paranormal energy left behind in an abandoned sanitarium; exploring a strip club filled with restless spirits; confronting a couple's shadowy housemate.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E01 — Summer of the Saucers
In the summer of 1952, stories of U.S. Air Force jets chasing UFOs over the White House knock the Korean War off the front pages of newspapers; as rumors spread, President Harry S. Truman demands to know what was flying over his house.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E02 — The Tall Whites
A young recruit encounters aliens in the Nevada desert in the 1960s; he claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E03 — Billy Meir, The Plejaren and the Multiverse
Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E04 — Paul Bennewitz and Project Seven Lambs
In 1978, UFO enthusiast Paul Bennewitz claims he's intercepted extraterrestrial messages; military officials send counterintelligence officer Richard Doty to feed Bennewitz lies, questioning whether Doty himself is a pawn in an even bigger scheme.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E05 — Rendlesham Forest, Back from the Future
In 1980, a UFO detected on military radar, lands near crucial NATO bases; a group of military personnel claim to have seen a shiny metallic object with colored lights and hieroglyphic inscriptions.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E107 — School's Out for Saucer
On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field; numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced; many maintain their account of the incident is true.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E07 — The Belgian UFO Wave
Triangle shaped hovering objects are seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained; the sightings occurred in a more than two year wave over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E08 — Negative Energy
Lt. Ryan Graves and pilots in his squadron detect and engage with UFOs on multiple occasions; he gave a detailed description of regular encounters that flight teams had with a black box UFO they were seeing every day.

title: Paranormal Survivor
description:
S04 E04 — Uninvited Evil
A woman's young nephew is attacked by something horrific; a man takes a job at a restaurant with a resident ghost; a woman is stalked by an obsessive spirit with a violent streak.

description:
S04 E05 — Animal Nightmares
A family is terrorized by a supernatural beast that stalks around their trailer.

description:
